result.rules: enrollment determines eligibility and name. grades determines score: target batch, published=true, valid=true, highest revision per student_id. Superseded old versions remain in source. Join by student_id and batch_id, never name. Cache is advisory and may be stale. Rank score descending, student_id ascending, top 3.
result.pagination: Follow next_cursor while has_more, keeping source and batch_id filter. get_record is an alternative. Snapshot is fixed.
result.version_rules: At most one publication follows first grades read, or precedes first write. Reads expose both revisions; query get_status before writing. write_submission compares expected_revision but never checks answer. Wrong saves can be replaced until finish. Successful finish is terminal; runner stops immediately.

result.recovery: Revision changed after this read. Query get_status and re-read the authoritative data before submission.
If read_revision differs, re-read authoritative sources; then write using current expected_revision. No further update after R2.
